title: Early clinical outcomes after switching to faricimab in previously treated diabetic macular edema

groups.description: Previously treated center-involving DME (3 + PRN conventional anti-VEGF without angiopoietin-2 inhibition) with persistent or recurrent fluid, switched to faricimab, four consecutive monthly injections

exclusions.what: T2 BCVA (logMAR) rows Baseline and Months 1-4 (R9-R13), values (C2) and mean changes (C3)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set and post-baseline selection (protocol inclusion 5; brief rulings on complete-case statements and post-baseline events): inclusion required completion of four consecutive monthly faricimab injections and BCVA data at baseline and Months 1, 2, 3 and 4 (Month 4 is the last tabulated visit), and assessed eyes were excluded because of incomplete treatment or follow-up data; eyes given any other anti-VEGF agent, intraocular corticosteroid, macular laser, cataract or vitreoretinal surgery between baseline and Month 4, or needing panretinal photocoagulation or vitreoretinal surgery during follow-up, were excluded from every visit. No admissible series remains.

exclusions.what: T1 baseline BCVA (R15); T2 CMT rows (R3-R7); T4 and T5 OCTA parameters; T6 adverse events
exclusions.reason: Baseline only, retinal thickness, OCTA parameters and adverse events are not extracted.

notes: BCVA was measured with a decimal acuity chart and converted to logMAR (Methods); T2 states logMAR with no decimal row.
Switch study: baseline is the last assessment before the first faricimab injection (T1 footnote).
